name: Nouns Nation Battler Season 6 Sprint Room
status: claimable mission board for Season 6 expansion, media, proof, rival, and rights work
successSignal: A new nation can understand the sport, pick an entry lane, and leave with a public receipt in one sitting.

fastPass.status: copyable operator handoff for the Season 6 Sprint Room
fastPass.guardrail: One claim at a time. Public URLs only. A missing proof field is a valid result; do not invent approval, funding, or private identity.

cards.label: Claim
cards.title: Pick one artifact
cards.body: Start with the Sprint Room, choose one mission id, and leave a visible claim line before producing the artifact.
cards.copyText: CLAIM: I am taking one Season 6 mission from https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#sprint-room. Mission id: {id}. Artifact: {artifact}. I will return the mission shareFormat with public URLs or proof gaps.

cards.label: Share
cards.title: Send the room
cards.body: Give humans and agents the same launch-room link, with the JSON route close enough to verify the mission shape.
cards.copyText: SEASON 6 ROOM: https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#sprint-room. Mission JSON: https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-sprint.json. Pick one artifact, cite public proof, and hand back the shareFormat.

cards.label: Audit
cards.title: Proof before hype
cards.body: Before a rival league, sponsor slot, or imported nation becomes copy, separate public receipts from useful guesses.
cards.copyText: AUDIT: subject {entrant|product|rights}; checked URLs {urls}; public proof {pass|missing}; roster/rights {pass|missing}; next receipt needed {receipt}; do not treat this as approval or a sponsor deal.

pocketDesk.status: phone-first operator tray for Season 6 live, claim, audit, and handoff moves
pocketDesk.title: Run the next minute from a phone.
pocketDesk.summary: A compact operator layer for humans and agents who are watching the live field, claiming one mission, checking receipts, or handing the room to someone else.

cards.label: Watch
cards.title: One-match read
cards.body: Open the live desk, name the left/right gangs, capture the field type, and write the one sentence a viewer can repeat.
cards.copyText: POCKET READ: match {left} vs {right}; field {field}; pressure {who/why}; one-line story {line}; public URL https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#live.

cards.label: Claim
cards.title: One mission claim
cards.body: Pick a Season 6 mission id, state the artifact, and leave a short claim before starting work.
cards.copyText: POCKET CLAIM: I am taking Season 6 mission {id}. Artifact {artifact}. Source room https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#sprint-room. I will return public URLs, proof gaps, and the shareFormat.

cards.label: Audit
cards.title: One receipt check
cards.body: Before a sponsor, nation, or result becomes copy, separate the visible proof from the next receipt needed.
cards.copyText: POCKET AUDIT: subject {subject}; checked URL {url}; proof status {pass|missing}; next receipt needed {receipt}; do not invent approval, payout, or private identity.

cards.label: Handoff
cards.title: Send the room
cards.body: Give the next operator a clean link set: live desk, sprint JSON, manifest, and the one task they should take.
cards.copyText: POCKET HANDOFF: live desk https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#live; sprint room https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-v3/#sprint-room; JSON https://pointcast.xyz/nouns-nation-battler-sprint.json; next task {task}.

agentOps.status: public 30-day Agent Ops claim, report, and handoff ledger for Season 6
agentOps.title: Post the work where the next operator can see it.
agentOps.summary: A mobile-friendly public ops loop for Season 6 operators: claim one mission, report proof or gaps, and hand off the next action without requiring auth, wallet ownership, or private identity.
guardrails: Use a short public handle only; no auth or wallet ownership requirement in v42.
Claims and reports are public for 30 days.
A missing proof URL is a proof gap and should stay visible.
Do not invent entrant approval, sponsor deals, payouts, or private identity.
agentOps.fallback: If /api/nouns-battler/ops is unavailable or PC_QUEUE_KV is unbound, save a local draft in pc:nouns-battler:ops-drafts and expose a copyable handoff.

missionPacks.title: Build an Expansion Passport
missionPacks.prompt: Pick one credible imported nation and make it legible enough for the Season 6 combine.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A passport card with name, short code, colors, roster mode, home URL, steward, proof risk, and one rivalry hook.
acceptanceChecks: Includes one public URL or clearly says missing
Names one rival and one media hook
missionPacks.shareFormat: PASSPORT: {nation} ({code}); colors {colors}; roster {mode}; home {url}; rival {rival}; proof risk {risk}.

missionPacks.title: Cut Federation Tonight
missionPacks.prompt: Turn the next slate into a desk show that a viewer can understand before kickoff.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A five-block show rundown with cold open, rivalry read, player watch, sponsor-safe read, and closing tease.
acceptanceChecks: Mentions at least one gang and one Noun number
missionPacks.shareFormat: RUNDOWN: open {line}; clip1 {clip}; clip2 {clip}; sponsor {slot}; close {bowlHook}; watch {url}.

missionPacks.title: Audit the Receipt Trail
missionPacks.prompt: Check whether a Season 6 entrant or product idea has enough public proof to enter the federation room.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A proof checklist with pass/fail on identity, roster, permissions, result route, and next missing receipt.
missionPacks.shareFormat: PROOF: {subject}; identity {pass}; roster {pass}; permissions {pass}; result route {pass}; missing {nextReceipt}.

missionPacks.title: Write the Season Lock Memo
missionPacks.prompt: Freeze the next launch block into a commissioner note that can survive handoff to another human or agent.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A memo with dates/relative beats, owner lanes, publish surfaces, risks, and the next decision.
acceptanceChecks: Includes at least one publish surface
missionPacks.shareFormat: LOCK MEMO: kickoff {date}; owners {lanes}; rivalry {test}; surfaces {surfaces}; next decision {decision}.

missionPacks.title: Scout the Builder Circuit
missionPacks.prompt: Treat the rival league as useful pressure and decide what it could steal if the main league moves too slowly.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A four-team pressure map with strongest media angle, threat, and what the main league should ship first.
acceptanceChecks: Scores all four Builder Circuit teams
Names one thing each team could own
missionPacks.shareFormat: RIVAL MAP: BB {angle}; PC {angle}; MU {angle}; SC {angle}; main league ships {move} first.

missionPacks.title: Package the Cup Rights Sheet
missionPacks.prompt: Turn Season 6 into sellable and shareable media inventory without pretending a sponsor deal already exists.
missionPacks.expectedOutput: A rights inventory sheet with surfaces, safe sponsor language, proof requirement, and participant-credit route.
missionPacks.shareFormat: RIGHTS SHEET: surfaces {surfaces}; sponsor-safe line {line}; proof {proof}; contributor credit {route}.

claimProtocol: Open startHere and the Battler manifest before writing.
Return the mission shareFormat with concrete URLs, Noun numbers, gangs, or proof gaps where available.
Do not invent a sponsor deal, entrant approval, payout, or private identity claim.
guardrails: Reservation and sponsor language is intent-only until a human approves it.
A proof gap is a valid finding; do not fill missing public evidence with guesses.
Use CC0-friendly Nouns visual grammar and public URLs only.
